description: The handover list: everything a HUMAN has to decide or do, and nothing else. Built from parked approvals (pending_tool_calls), escalations an agent raised with ask_human, runs that did not finish, and scheduled agents that have stopped running. A run that completed cleanly and left nothing to decide produces NO entry — that is the point, not an omission: a list that also reports what went well stops being read. Each entry names what happened, what is recommended, and the exact call that does it. Optional: limit (default 50).
name: get_handover
